contentPattern.structure: search input + Go submit button + results heading + results/no-results list

suitableFor: any page needing a styled client-side search backed by query-index.json
notSuitableFor: inline / minimal typeahead search without a Go button
faceted or backend-driven search requiring server pagination
reuseGuidance.notes: Functional client-side replacement for the source's dynamic backend search. Author provides a single link to the search index source (e.g. /query-index.json). Styling matches the Northera source: #cacaca-bordered white input, #24475d Go button, #245778 'Search results' heading.
